correctness.rationale: The twelve cube edges and all eight forbidden three-stars are constructed without assumptions beyond the fixed graph. Exhaustive enumeration checks all 4096 masks, 1699 augmented faces, complete sequential acyclic Morse matching (847 pairs; five critical faces), and directed Hasse acyclicity. The exact signed integral Morse boundary is the primitive row [-1,1,-1,-1]; a degree-one 5-cell kills the unique 4-cell, yielding three 5-spheres and no torsion. An independent raw mod-two simplicial boundary computation confirms degree-five rank three and all others zero. Exhaustive signed Lefschetz traces for all 48 B3 elements match the twisted signed-coordinate formula, and the elementary irreducibility argument uses the three distinct flip weights.

originality.rationale: Candidate-specific searches under both the clique-free line-graph and two-matching/bounded-degree aliases did not identify an equivalent integral cube classification or 48-element rational homology character. The full text of the motivating clique-free paper and three directly relevant graph-complex works was compared by mathematical implications: known chordal shellability, complete/complete-bipartite cases, selected two-matching families, and ordinary line-graph clique complexes do not entail the cube result. The closest indexed exact result treats M_2(K_4,4), whose induced restriction to the twelve cube edges is not homotopy-determined by the ambient complex. Residual unindexed or partially inaccessible older work is acknowledged.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical cube two-matching complex and, simultaneously, the triangle-free complex of the cuboctahedral line graph, bridging two active natural graph-complex constructions. Its 49 facets span dimensions five through seven, yet the exact integral homotopy type consists of precisely three five-spheres; the degree-one Morse attachment is therefore genuinely informative beyond f-vectors or mod-two ranks. The irreducible sign-twisted B3 action and absence of invariant classes refine that topology with natural canonical symmetry data. This is a complete motivated natural finite classification, rather than an arbitrary induced slice or routine coefficient substitution.
